peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 28.5% above its local comparables; 35 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (65.5): 3.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 35 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2001.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Marine Parade MRT about 210 m, Tanjong Katong MRT about 670 m; closer than 42 of 63 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Tanjong Katong Primary School about 630 m; more than 37 of 63 similar developments (the same as 17). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 170 m), more than 39 of 63 similar developments (the same as 5); nearest hawker centre Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre about 330 m; nearest park Marine Parade Rd Park about 100 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amber House, 31 new sales, about 360 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 770 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 790 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 940 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,270 m; K Suites, 6 new sales, about 1,390 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 1,420 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,420 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 372 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 389 new sales and 753 resales (1,142 purchases); new sales were 34.1% of these purchases. Subsales (42) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 753 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 40 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 753 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 876 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
